svg.title: One cross-section of the wafer. Three holes with sloping walls go down through a thin flat oxide and a dotted glass: two to the silicon of the active areas and a shallower one in the middle to the top of the wide stack. Nothing is in the holes. The drawing is the same as the state before the step.

Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
